recent.title: QPaint Quote Intake — False Completion
recent.summary: 3 quotes marked complete with $0 deal values. Root cause: no certification gate between extraction and label. Fixed: certify_intake_complete() + Intake Exception state.

recent.title: ATTEMPTED ≠ COMPLETED
recent.summary: Automation success ≠ business outcome success. Every critical workflow must verify the business state, not just the process completion.

recent.title: HTTP 200 ≠ Application Success
recent.summary: HQ certification requires visual rendering verification, not just HTTP status. Deploy → verify dependencies → verify render → certify.

call_framework.opening: G'day [name], James here. I emailed you recently but thought I'd give you a quick call. I've been speaking with painting businesses about what happens after they send a quote. What do you normally do once you've sent one?
call_framework.if_no: G'day, James here. Is the owner around? I wanted a quick word about how you follow up your quotes.
call_framework.proof: Travis Krieg Painting: 14 recovered jobs / $180,115 recovered revenue — use only if it lands naturally.
discovery: What actually happens after you send a quote?
Who follows them up, and how many times?
Do you know your quote-to-job conversion rate?
Do quotes just sit in the system and go quiet?

objection_handling.already_have_a_system: That's great — let's see if we can make it work harder for you.
objection_handling.too_busy: That's exactly the point — this runs itself.
objection_handling.not_interested: No worries at all — thanks for your time.

founder_call_day.voicemail: G'day [name], James Hardstaff here from Not Forgotten. I'll send you a quick email so it's not a cold call next time. Cheers.

all_calls.brief: PRIORITY #1 — WARM. Client Probability 83 (highest). No objection recorded. Cleanest re-open (no V2 email). ~3 weeks silence since 29 Jul chat, zero replies ever. Desired outcome: walkthrough or a defined next action.
all_calls.icp_fit: Highest-probability re-engagement — warm, took a 3-min call, no objection recorded.
all_calls.opening: G'day, James here. We spoke a few weeks back about what happens after you send a quote. I wanted to follow up and see whether it's something you'd like to look at properly.
discovery: Since we spoke, have you had any quotes go quiet that you'd have liked to get back?
When a quote doesn't come back, what do you normally do about it?
If we sat down for ten minutes and looked at your recent quotes, do you reckon we'd find some that have slipped through?
all_calls.prior_contact: V1 Email 1-4 (Jul), 3-min call 29 Jul. No V2 email.

all_calls.brief: PRIORITY #2 — WARM / CONSIDERING (evaluating options). Client Probability 57. Previously 'interested but not urgent'. Desired outcome: identify blocker, move to a walkthrough if appropriate.
all_calls.icp_fit: Active buyer signal (Considering) — best positioned for a walkthrough of their own quotes.
all_calls.opening: G'day, James here from Not Forgotten. We had a quick chat recently and you mentioned you were still weighing it up. I wanted to see where you've landed and whether there's anything I can help clarify.
discovery: When you send a quote and don't hear back, what do you normally do — chase it yourself, or let it go?
Roughly how many quotes would you have sitting out there right now that you're not sure about?
What's the main thing making you hesitate — the price, the time it'd take, or whether it'd actually work for your business?
all_calls.prior_contact: V1 Email 1-4 (Jul), brief chat 29 Jul, V2 Email 1 14 Aug.

all_calls.brief: PRIORITY #3 — STALLED OPPORTUNITY (NOT a trial). Agreed to proceed 23 Jul, never completed onboarding or payment. Founder re-engaged 16 & 19 Aug (no reply). Desired outcome: restart onboarding or close honestly.
all_calls.icp_fit: Closest to a paying customer — only prospect past 'interest' toward agreement.
all_calls.opening: G'day Ahmad, James here. We set things up a few weeks back and then it went quiet on both sides. I wanted to check in — is this still something you want to move forward with, or has the timing changed?
discovery: When we set things up, what stopped you from finishing it?
Are you still sending quotes and losing track of them the way you were when we first spoke?
If we got this working, what would it need to look like for you to feel it's worth $199 a month?
